title: Text and date functions for cleaning

videos.script: Here is an export from the system Café Serra used before this one. Twelve orders from December 2024. {{export}} Every value is there, and almost none of it is usable. A name with two spaces in front of it. The same channel written three ways. A quantity with a unit typed after the number. A date that is eight digits long. {{faults}} A person reads past all of that without noticing. A formula does not. To COUNTIFS, wholesale with a space at the end is a different word. To SUM, six un is not a number at all. {{formulas}} This lesson cleans the list with formulas, one column at a time, and never by retyping. TRIM takes out the extra spaces. LEFT and FIND cut a code out of a longer text. VALUE turns text back into a number. DATE builds a real date out of its parts. {{clean}} Each fix goes into a new column beside the old one, so you can always see what changed and why. {{columns}} And every fix ends with a count, the habit from lesson one. Twelve rows went in. Twelve numbers have to come out. {{check}}
